name: Pilum Strike Team
legend: Comprising veterans in the theatre of ship-to-ship void war, pilum strike teams are cast through the void like a spear aboard shrouded boarding torpedoes to infiltrate key enemy warships. Once aboard, the Phobos-armoured Space Marines wage a terror campaign to destabilise the target vessel from within.

rules.name: Relentless Salvoes
rules.legend: These vanguard specialists stay on the move, laying down hails of fire to harass and disrupt their foes even as they hit-and-fade through chambers and corridors.
rules.description_html: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: KNIFE WORK
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
stratagems.type: Pilum Strike Team – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

enhancements.name: Omni-Structural Auspex
enhancements.legend: A rare device with a potent and knowledgeable machine spirit, this implement analyses the integrity of foes’ armour and isolates weaknesses to exploit.
enhancements.description_html: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES model (excluding Character models) makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Void Warrior
enhancements.legend: Having mastered the arts of shipboard warfare over many battles, this warrior moves swiftly through them and strikes with unerring skill.
enhancements.description_html: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
